query:
select
                purchases.id,
                purchases.product_id,
                purchases.purchaser_id,
                purchases.owner_id,
                owner.name as "owner_name?",
                (purchases.refunded_id is not null) as "refunded!",
                (select transaction_id from purchase_transactions
                    where purchase_id = purchases.id and transaction_id is not null
                    order by completed_at limit 1) as "transaction_id?",
                (select array(select group_id from group_memberships
                 where user_id = owner_id)) as owner_memberships
            from purchases
            left join users owner on owner.id = owner_id
            where purchases.product_id = $1
            order by purchases.id
